note: The only place in this codebase where a model identifier appears. Every price, context window and use_cases list below was read from flavors[].model_id in the catalog of the model's provider on that provider's catalog_retrieved_at. Bumping any identifier here MUST bump pipeline_version, because stored caption vectors and evaluation records are keyed by it. The response cache key names the provider and the model as well, so a cached answer is never served for another model.
providers_note: Where hosted requests go, as data. A provider states its endpoint, the one environment variable its credential is read from, and the catalog its models are checked against, read by catalog_format. Every model names its provider and no code names one. The origin a provider's requests reach is derived from base_url in the egress allowlist's own spelling, never stated a second time, and a provider whose origin the deployment's allowlist does not declare is refused by name.

nebius_token_factory.description: Nebius Token Factory, which serves open models behind one OpenAI-compatible API.

nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning.description: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, an open reasoning model from NVIDIA.
nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning.note: Runtime-verified 2026-08-27: HTTP 200, echoed model field matches. Spends roughly 150 to 215 reasoning tokens on every call and there is no way to switch that off, which is where min_max_tokens comes from.

nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B.description: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B, an open reasoning model from NVIDIA.
nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B.note: Primary for reasoning_cheap. The callable identifier includes both vendor prefixes exactly as listed. The configured context window is smaller than the Lightning fallback window.

nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b.description: Nemotron 3 Super 120B, an open reasoning model from NVIDIA.
nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b.note: Configured as the reasoning_mid primary and reasoning_hard fallback. No production caller selects reasoning_mid. The callable identifier uses lowercase letters as listed.

nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b.description: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B, an open reasoning model from NVIDIA.
nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b.note: Configured as the reasoning_hard primary, with no production caller. Availability and task-specific quality must be evaluated before adoption; configuration alone does not establish either.

MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.description: MiniMax M3, an open model from MiniMax that reads text and images.
MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.note: Runtime-verified 2026-08-27 to accept an image_url content part and describe the image correctly, despite catalog_type reading text2text. use_cases is authoritative, type is not. Measured 277 prompt tokens at 256px and 772 at 768px.

openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5.description: MiniCPM-V 4.5, an open model from OpenBMB that reads images.
openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5.note: Vision fallback. Both the type field and the use_cases list agree it takes images, so it is the safe side of the type-versus-use_cases disagreement. A 32K context is the reason it is not the primary.

Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507.description: Qwen3 235B Instruct, an open model from the Qwen team that answers without reasoning first.
Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507.note: Primary for structured_extraction, used for request classification, query planning, appearance drafts and environment-operation drafts. Structured output is validated by the client and the calling feature.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash, an open reasoning model from DeepSeek.
deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731.note: The dated identifier, not the undated one. The undated deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash is scheduled for removal from Serverless on 2026-08-31 and must not be referenced.

Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B.description: Qwen3 Embedding 8B, an open model from the Qwen team that turns text into vectors for search.
Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B.note: Runtime-verified 2026-08-27 to return 4096 dimensions, not the 1024 the schema document assumed.

local_models_note: Checkpoints this codebase runs on its own hardware, pinned by HuggingFace revision SHA. Nothing here is a Token Factory identifier, so the preflight neither reads nor checks this section, and parse_manifest ignores it. license is read from the raw README.md YAML frontmatter at the pinned revision, never from the catalog, a model card's prose or the family name, and exulanica/ingest/stages/segmentation.py re-reads that frontmatter before it loads the segmentation weights and refuses on drift. readme_sha256 is the digest of those README bytes as retrieved on retrieved_at. pipeline_version moved from 2 to 3 when the segmentation entries were added; the depth entry, added later, named the checkpoint the worker already ran and moved nothing.

facebook/sam2.1-hiera-tiny.note: SAM 2.1, the smallest checkpoint. Loaded as Sam2Model from a sam2_video configuration, which transformers warns about and which returned predicted IoU above 0.99 on the first measured volcanic photograph. Never SAM 3: the SAM License is gated and CUDA 12.6 only, see docs/license-matrix.md section 3.4.

IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny.provenance_caveat: Trained in part on Cap4M, an undisclosed web-crawled caption set whose terms IDEA-Research has not published. The Apache-2.0 grant covers the grantor's own rights and cannot cure third-party rights in scraped data; docs/license-matrix.md section 7 records the same residual.
IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny.note: Open-vocabulary boxes for photographs the hosted vision pass did not locate objects in.

google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble.note: The card's research-output framing is a norm, not a licence term (docs/license-matrix.md section 3.4).

Ruicheng/moge-2-vitl.note: MoGe-2 ViT-L, the checkpoint every existing point map names. The README at this revision is its frontmatter and nothing else. Loaded by the moge package, which does not re-read this frontmatter before loading. The depth stage binds repo@revision, so moving this pin re-keys every point map and is a decision of its own; it does not move pipeline_version, which keys hosted responses and caption vectors.

object_segmentation.rationale: Masks from boxes, locally, so a photograph with a person in it never leaves the machine to be segmented. No fallback: the licence matrix clears no other promptable segmenter, and a stage with no segmenter reports itself unavailable rather than substituting one.

open_vocabulary_detection.rationale: Boxes for SAM when the hosted vision pass supplied none. The fallback is tried when the primary cannot be loaded or raises, and the artifact records which one ran.

depth.rationale: Metric point maps, locally, for the depth stage. Moved here on 2026-09-16 from worker environment defaults, with the same checkpoint, so the depth model is stated where every other model is and a personal model right can name it by role. No fallback: a worker that cannot load this checkpoint reports depth unavailable rather than substituting another.

timeout_rule_note: A hosted request is abandoned once its role's timeout_seconds have passed since it was sent, whether or not bytes are still arriving. Each timeout is derived from its basis by timeout_rule, and parse_manifest refuses one that is not: longest_ms times headroom_factor, rounded up to a whole multiple of round_up_to_seconds. The headroom covers a tail the recorded calls did not reach; the rounding keeps one new measurement from moving the bound. Re-run scripts/survey_hosted_call_latency.py --write and restate the basis when the records grow or a primary changes.
chosen_roles_note: A chosen role has no model of its own here. The world names one, for a person or a group, among the models whose declared answering fits the caller's contract, and with no choice nothing is asked. A model answers a chosen role only by a mechanism its answering map names, each mechanism naming the record whose probe verified it; a model whose map names none is offered to no chosen role. Its calls have no fallback, because a choice names one model, and no timeout of their own: the caller bounds each call by its contract.

society_decision.rationale: A person in a world choosing what to do next, asked through the society's decision contract (assets/catalogs/society/society-decision-policy.v1.json and society-decision-action.v1.json). The world's owner chooses the model; with no choice the built-in planner decides and no model is asked.

timeout_basis.note: Single composer calls on the Companion answer path. No retained record measures the Lightning fallback, which serves under this timeout when the primary is withdrawn.

reasoning_cheap.rationale: Used by selection.question.compose_answer to produce cited Companion answers from validated evidence packets. The comparison in docs/evaluation/2026-09-09-companion-memory.json supports Nano latency and validator conformance on four packets; it does not establish general reasoning quality or coverage of every continuity decision. Model-unavailability errors can select Lightning. Answer validation failures receive a repair attempt and then a deterministic answer, not automatic escalation to a larger model.

timeout_basis.note: Eight per-question answers from the pre-registered model comparison, each one composer call or two when repaired. No production caller.

reasoning_mid.rationale: Configured reasoning candidate with no production caller. Adoption requires task-specific quality comparisons against the current caller baseline. Its declared Lightning fallback handles model-unavailability errors; no automatic quality escalation selects this role.

timeout_basis.note: Eight per-question answers from the pre-registered model comparison, each one composer call or two when repaired. No production caller.

reasoning_hard.rationale: Configured reasoning candidate with no production caller. No task-specific comparison establishes an advantage for Companion answers or continuity reasoning. Promotion requires evidence of improved answer quality and task success. The declared Super fallback handles model-unavailability errors; this role is not an implemented quality escalation path.

timeout_basis.note: Every row bounds one vision call from above: a photograph's one or two calls in the place-proposal outcomes, or a whole ingest capture in the rehearsal. The photographs are synthetic drawings.

vision.rationale: One structured-extraction pass per photograph at ingest. The primary is chosen on measured behaviour: it is a third the input price of the fallback, carries 32x the context, and was runtime-verified to comprehend an image rather than merely accept the request.

timeout_basis.note: Single classifier, planner and drafter calls.

structured_extraction.rationale: Used by classify_request, propose_plan, draft_appearance and draft_environment_operation for structured intent, query and authored-change proposals. Callers validate these outputs before execution or presentation. The declared DeepSeek fallback handles model-unavailability errors, not failed quality checks or an automatic transfer of work from the reasoning role.

timeout_basis.note: Single query-vector calls on the Companion answer path, timed around the client call.

embedding.rationale: The only embedding-typed model in the catalog. This role has NO same-tier runtime fallback and the client says so loudly rather than degrading into a different vector space, which would silently poison every stored embedding.
